head: ^(usage: mhw milestone [a-z]+ |mhw milestone [a-z]+: error: )
why: A usage error names the command the caller typed: argparse printed the script's file name and its own usage layout; the CLI prints mhw milestone <verb> and its own usage line. The exit code (2) is unchanged and still compared.

head: ^(usage: mhw milestone [a-z]+ |mhw milestone [a-z]+: error: )
why: Same as usage-not-a-number: the usage text names mhw milestone update instead of milestone-update.py, and argparse wrapped its usage over several indented lines. The exit code (2) is unchanged and still compared.
